data.title: Sound is a team sport.
data.intro: SonicForge is a one-producer studio that helps artists finish records they are proud of.

children.text: I started out recording friends in a spare bedroom with one microphone and a borrowed interface. Years later the gear is better, the room is quieter and the approach is the same: listen first, make decisions that serve the song, and never let the technology get louder than the feeling.

I work with singers, bands and writers who arrive with anything from a voice memo to a half-built session. Some want a producer in the room from the first chord; others only need a mix that finally translates to the car.
How a project runs

We start with a listening session and a short conversation about where the song should land. Then we build, record and refine in the studio, usually a few days at a time, with you hearing every version as it changes.
When the record is done I mix and master it here, so the sound you approved in the room is the sound that leaves it. You keep the sessions and the stems.
What I care about
Honest performances, space in the mix and finishing things. Great sound should feel at home on a phone speaker as much as on a big system.

data.title: A creative home for bold ideas.
data.intro: A purpose-built studio for writing, recording, mixing and finishing, where great sound feels at home.

children.text: SonicForge is a small private studio: one control room, one live room, a vocal booth and a lounge for listening back. Sessions are booked for a single artist or band at a time, so the room is yours for the day.
Every project starts with a conversation, so tell me about the song and I will suggest the right mix of rooms, time and services.

data.title: Booking terms.
data.intro: A plain-language summary of how sessions are booked, paid for and delivered.

children.text: Booking
A session is confirmed once a date is agreed by email. Dates can be moved with 48 hours notice.
Delivery
Final mixes and masters are delivered as high-resolution files within the time agreed at the start of the project. Two rounds of revisions are included.
Ownership
You own your songs and recordings. The studio asks only for permission to mention the project in its credits list.
These sample terms are placeholder text for the theme and are not legal advice.

data.title: Higher Ground
data.summary: Five songs written over one slow winter and recorded in a single week in the live room.
data.credits: Artist: Lena Ray. Produced and mixed at SonicForge. Mastering by an outside engineer.

children.text: The brief was warmth: acoustic guitar, a borrowed piano and room sound left in on purpose.
We tracked everything live with the lamps on, then built the record around the first takes.

data.title: Midnight Thoughts
data.summary: A late-night single built from a voice memo, finished start to end in the studio.
data.credits: Artist: Jae Kell. Produced, mixed and mastered at SonicForge.

children.text: Jae arrived with a phone recording of a hummed chorus. Two sessions later it was a finished song.
The vocal is the first take, kept because nothing we recorded afterwards felt as honest.

data.title: Same Skies
data.summary: A four-piece band record, recorded elsewhere and mixed and mastered here.
data.credits: Artist: The Vars. Mixed and mastered at SonicForge.

children.text: The band self-recorded in a rehearsal room and sent over the session. The job was to give it depth without losing the rough edges.
Mastering aimed for a record that sounds the same on earbuds and on a big system.

data.title: Still Here
data.summary: A quiet, spacious album produced over three months of short sessions.
data.credits: Artist: Elio. Produced at SonicForge. Mixed and mastered elsewhere.

children.text: Elio wanted the feeling of a still sea: very little movement, a lot of space.
We recorded sparse arrangements and resisted adding anything that did not earn its place.

data.title: Afterglow
data.summary: A single mixed for vinyl, with extra attention to low end and stereo width.
data.credits: Artist: Marlo Quinn. Mixed at SonicForge.

children.text: The mix was prepared with a vinyl cut in mind, so bass and top end stay controlled.

data.title: Midnight Skies
data.summary: A moody single produced from scratch with a vocalist and a drum machine.
data.credits: Artist: Tavi Rowe. Produced at SonicForge.

children.text: We started with a drum pattern and a single chord and let the song find its own shape.

data.title: Further Still
data.summary: A coastal indie EP mastered for consistent loudness across five songs.
data.credits: Artist: Harbour Lights. Mastered at SonicForge.

children.text: Mastering focused on keeping the songs dynamic while matching their level and tone.

data.title: Slow Light
data.summary: A slow ballad mixed and mastered with the vocal front and centre.
data.credits: Artist: Odell Park. Mixed and mastered at SonicForge.

children.text: The vocal sits close and dry, with a long soft reverb that only appears between the lines.
